technology_name: A MODULAR MAGNETO-RHEOLOGICAL FLUID CLUTCH APPARATUS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Powertrain Component / Fluid Clutch Unit
problem_solved: Standard mechanical fluid clutches suffer from sluggish engagement responses, mechanical plate friction wear, and struggle to alter torque output profiles adaptively under changing loads.
description: A high-precision modular power transmission apparatus containing an input rotor disk and a concentric output rotor disc enclosed inside a stepped-groove housing packed with active magnetorheological (MR) fluid managed by electromagnetic coils.
applications: Adaptive robotics joint actuators, automotive smart torque vectoring modules, heavy industrial manufacturing conveyor drives, and marine powertrain safety assemblies.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
